subject.title: refactor(channels): move inbound turn execution into core

question: Should the optional resolver-only `configOverride` remain an accepted public/runtime dispatch-contract field, or should the Teams timezone behavior use a narrower owner-specific seam?
rationale: The change is additive but expands a shared dispatch surface used by bundled channels; repository policy requires maintainer-visible direction for plugin API surface changes.

options.title: Accept the narrow resolver override
options.body: Keep `configOverride` limited to reply resolution, document its compatibility intent in review, and merge only after a clean rebase plus final-head proof.

options.title: Use a Teams-specific resolver seam
options.body: Remove the shared override parameter and preserve sender-timezone behavior through a narrower Microsoft Teams-owned integration point.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow resolver override
recommendation.body: Keep `configOverride` limited to reply resolution, document its compatibility intent in review, and merge only after a clean rebase plus final-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored both the merged predecessor and the follow-up contract change, making them the clearest history-based routing candidate.
